input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewal terms are twelve months (no multi-year auto-renewal), Customer may opt out on only thirty days' written notice, and Vendor must send a renewal reminder sixty days in advance — with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed, which is better than the playbook baseline. Section 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. This meets the preferred position on every material term, so no redline is warranted.
